result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with both the image and the restaurant name truncated. The name appears to be clipped mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container properly indicates there are more items (e.g., with a visible scroll affordance or fade effect) and that partially visible cards are clipped cleanly. The restaurant name should not be truncated in a way that obscures the full name without a clear indicator.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen without any visual indicator that the user can scroll down to see more content.
issues.suggestion: This is a common pattern to hint at scrollability, but consider adding a subtle scroll indicator or ensuring enough of the card is visible to clearly imply scrollability to the user.
